text.en: Ministry of Education Singapore, Curriculum Planning and Development Division. Mathematics Syllabus Primary One to Six (implementation starting with the 2021 Primary One cohort; updated October 2025). Statistics: pp. 32, 34, 36 and 40; Fraction of a Set: p. 37.
text.zh: 新加坡教育部课程规划与发展司：《小学一至六年级数学课程纲要》（2021 年版，2025 年 10 月更新）。统计：第 32、34、36、40 页；一组的几分之几：第 37 页。

note.en: The only source for what each step covers; the syllabus lines are quoted from it (pages as printed on the PDF, read 2026-11-15). Pie charts are a P4 line on p. 40, with tables and line graphs.
note.zh: 每一步学什么，只以这份课纲为准；课纲条目照原文引用（页码是 PDF 上印的页码，2026-11-15 读取）。饼图在第 40 页四年级的条目里，和表格、折线图同一条。

text.en: Ministry of Education Singapore: primary syllabuses page.
text.zh: 新加坡教育部：小学课程纲要页面。

note.zh: 用于核对 S1 的版本。

text.en: Ministry of Education Singapore: approved textbook list (for the usual order of topics only, not copied).
text.zh: 新加坡教育部：批准教材目录（只参考通常的教学顺序，不照抄）。

note.en: Questions, pictures and wording in this lesson are our own; every number is made up about one class, one stall or one week, and claims no real survey.
note.zh: 本课的题目、插图和措辞都是自己写的；所有数字都是虚构的，说的是一个班、一个摊位或一周，不代表任何真实调查。

text.en: Bell, A. & Janvier, C. (1981). The interpretation of graphs representing situations. For the Learning of Mathematics 2(1), 34–41, p. 37.
text.zh: Bell, A. 与 Janvier, C.（1981）：对表示情境的图像的解读。《数学学习》（For the Learning of Mathematics）第 2 卷第 1 期，34–41 页，第 37 页。

note.en: Asked when a line graph rose most, pupils often answered where its value was highest; the authors call this the "increase vs value" distraction (the code height-for-change, line graphs). Read 2026-11-16. The lesson's misconceptions and feedback are its own design; this source only shows the idea has been seen in children's work. No figures, wording or frequencies are taken from it.
note.zh: 问折线图哪一段升得最多，学生常常答数值最高的地方；作者称之为"增加量与数值"的混淆（误解码 height-for-change，折线图）。2026-11-16 读过。本课的误解目录和反馈是自己设计的；这份来源只说明孩子确实会这样想，不取它的数字、措辞或出现频率。

text.en: Common Core Standards Writing Team (2011). Progressions for the Common Core State Standards in Mathematics (draft, 20 June 2011): K–3, Categorical Data; Grades 2–5, Measurement Data, pp. 4 and 6.
text.zh: Common Core 标准写作组（2011）：《Common Core 数学标准进程（草稿，2011 年 6 月 20 日）：K–3 分类数据；2–5 年级测量数据》，第 4、6 页。

note.en: "How many more" questions read from scaled bar graphs, and the bar graph's axis as a count scale (bar graphs, the codes value-for-difference and between-gridlines). For the order of teaching only. Read 2026-11-16. The lesson's misconceptions and feedback are its own design; this source only shows the idea has been seen in children's work. No figures, wording or frequencies are taken from it.
note.zh: 从有刻度的条形图上回答"多多少"，条形图的轴是计数刻度（条形图，误解码 value-for-difference、between-gridlines）。只参考教学顺序。2026-11-16 读过。本课的误解目录和反馈是自己设计的；这份来源只说明孩子确实会这样想，不取它的数字、措辞或出现频率。

text.en: Correll, M., Bertini, E. & Franconeri, S. (2020). Truncating the y-axis: Threat or menace? Proceedings of CHI 2020 (arXiv:1907.02035).
text.zh: Correll, M.、Bertini, E. 与 Franconeri, S.（2020）：截断纵轴：威胁还是祸害？CHI 2020 会议论文（arXiv:1907.02035）。

note.en: Bar charts whose axis does not start at 0 make differences look bigger than they are (the code truncated-axis). A study with adults, not children. Read 2026-11-16. The lesson's misconceptions and feedback are its own design; this source only shows the idea has been seen in children's work. No figures, wording or frequencies are taken from it.
note.zh: 纵轴不从 0 开始的条形图会让差别看起来比实际大（误解码 truncated-axis）。研究对象是成人，不是儿童。2026-11-16 读过。本课的误解目录和反馈是自己设计的；这份来源只说明孩子确实会这样想，不取它的数字、措辞或出现频率。
